title: Kickoff call
summary: Rohini explained that Threadline currently sells through Instagram and WhatsApp and wants a proper store before Diwali. Decisions: payments will use Stripe hosted Checkout with cards only at launch, the colour theme is off-white with deep indigo and a mustard accent, and the first storefront demo is on 14 August. Rohini will send product photos and prices for about 60 products by 28 August. Open question: she asked for a 'modern dashboard with analytics' but did not say which numbers she wants to see; she said she would think about it.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: Good morning Rohini. Thank you for joining. With me are Ananya, who will work on the frontend, and Rukhsar, who will handle the backend and payments.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Hello, hello. Nice to meet you both. I am very excited, I have been wanting a proper website for two years now.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Hello ma'am. Can you please tell us how you are selling today?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Right now everything is on Instagram. Someone messages, my assistant Komal sends photos on WhatsApp, they pay by UPI and send a screenshot. It works but it is a full-time job. In festival season we miss messages and lose orders.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: So the main goal is that the customer can choose a product and pay on the website without messaging you. Is that correct?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Yes, exactly. Pick, pay, done. And I should get to know there is an order.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: How many products do you want at launch?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Around sixty. Kurtas, dupattas, stoles, sarees, some jackets, and a small home section, cushion covers and all. So six categories.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: For the design, do you have any colours in mind? Or any website you like?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Our tags are indigo, so deep indigo for sure. Off-white background, like khadi cloth. And maybe a little mustard for buttons. Please no bright red, it looks like a sale website. I want it to feel like a boutique.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Okay. Off-white, deep indigo, mustard accent. I will make the home page with big photos and share on 14 August.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: 14 August is fine. I am travelling to Bagru that week but I can see it on my phone.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: About payment. We suggest Stripe Checkout. The customer goes to a secure Stripe page, pays by card, and comes back to your site. We do not store any card details.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Will UPI work? Most of my customers use UPI.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: UPI through Stripe needs extra approval on your Stripe account and that can take time. Our suggestion is launch with cards first and add UPI as a second phase once your account is approved.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Hmm. Okay, cards first. But please keep it in mind, UPI is important for me later.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: Noted. And you also wanted discount codes?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Yes, for repeat customers. If someone buys a lot, give them a code for next time. Komal does this by hand now.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: One more thing. For my side, I want a modern dashboard with analytics. My friend has a store and she showed me hers, it has graphs and everything. I want something like that.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Sure ma'am. Which numbers do you want to see on it?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Oh, you know, the usual. How things are going. Sales and all that. You people know better what should be there. Let me think about it and tell you.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: That is fine. We will send you a few questions on WhatsApp about it. Last point: we need product photos, descriptions and prices from you. Can we say 28 August?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: 28 August, yes. Komal will put everything in a Google Drive folder. Photos are already shot for most of it.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: Thank you. So to confirm: Stripe Checkout with cards at launch, indigo and off-white theme, first demo on 14 August, content by 28 August. We will meet again after the demo.

title: Progress update
summary: The team demoed the storefront, cart and test-mode checkout. Rohini approved the home page and asked for the product card buttons to change from mustard to indigo with mustard only on the cart button. Decisions: free shipping above Rs 2,500 and a flat Rs 99 below that, and a 10% coupon for customers who spend Rs 5,000 or more. Rohini mentioned that during her own test payments, twice the money was taken but no order appeared; nobody on the call identified the cause and Rukhsar will investigate. The analytics dashboard was raised again and Rohini still did not specify which metrics she wants.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: Hello Rohini. Today Ananya will show the storefront and Rukhsar will show the payment flow in test mode.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Yes, I saw the link Ananya sent last week. I liked it very much. Komal also liked it.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Thank you ma'am. I am sharing my screen. This is the home page with six categories. When you click on Kurtas, the products come with photo, name and price, and Add to cart button.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Nice. The photos look big, that is what I wanted. One thing, the mustard button on every product is too much. It looks like a row of yellow. Can those be indigo, and keep mustard only for the cart button on top?

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Yes, I can do that. Add to cart in indigo, mustard only for the cart button.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: Now the cart. You can change quantity, apply a coupon code, and then Proceed to Checkout goes to the Stripe page. After payment the customer comes back to a success page and the order is saved.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: About that. I tried it myself with the test card you gave me. I did maybe eight or nine payments. Two times it took the payment, I could see it in that Stripe screen, but the order did not show up on our side. I don't know what I did wrong.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: Do you remember what happened on the screen those two times?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Not really. I was on my phone in the car, network was coming and going. One time I think I closed the tab quickly because a call came. But the money had gone, it was showing paid. With real customers this will be a big problem, they will shout at us.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: Okay. I will check it. I could not see this problem on my laptop till now, so I need to try again.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: Rukhsar, please write down exactly what Rohini described and look at how the order gets created after payment. We will discuss in our mentor session.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Please do. I don't understand the technical part, I only know paid customer and no order is the worst thing.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: Understood. Next question is shipping charges. What should we charge?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Free shipping above two thousand five hundred. Below that, flat ninety-nine rupees. All India same.

segments.speaker: Student (Rukhsar)
segments.text: And for the coupon, right now the code gives a gift coupon when someone spends above a limit. What limit and how much discount?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: If they spend five thousand or more, give ten percent off on the next order. Valid for one month.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Ma'am, about the analytics dashboard. I sent some questions on WhatsApp last week about which numbers you want.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Yes, sorry, I saw it and forgot to reply. Honestly I am not sure. I just want it to look modern, with graphs. My friend's one had a nice line going up. Whatever is important for a business like mine.

segments.speaker: Student (Ananya)
segments.text: Okay ma'am.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: We will come back to you on that with something to react to. Rohini, the product content is due on 28 August. Is that on track?

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Komal has done forty products. The sarees are pending because the photographer is late. You will have most of it by 28th, sarees maybe first week of September.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Sunita)
segments.text: Alright. So decisions today: product buttons in indigo, free shipping above Rs 2,500 and Rs 99 below, 10% coupon on orders of Rs 5,000 or more valid for one month. Rukhsar will look into the missing orders. Next demo is 11 September.

segments.speaker: Client (Rohini)
segments.text: Perfect. Thank you girls, it is coming along nicely.
